title: 400 HeaderMismatch from an MCP server on protocol 2026-07-28
symptoms: 400 Bad Request with a HeaderMismatch JSON-RPC error, code -32020
400 with UnsupportedProtocolVersionError listing the server's supported versions
A custom client that worked against 2025 servers fails against a 2026-07-28 server
cause: Under 2026-07-28 every POST must carry Mcp-Method (and Mcp-Name for tools/call, resources/read, prompts/get) plus an MCP-Protocol-Version header that matches the version in the body's _meta. A missing or mismatched header is rejected, and an unknown version gets UnsupportedProtocolVersionError.
fix: Set the headers from the same values as the JSON body on every request, base64 encode a name that is not plain ASCII, and pick the version from the server's supported list.
affected: MCP protocol 2026-07-28; error codes renumbered in that revision (HeaderMismatch -32020, UnsupportedProtocolVersion -32022)
